changelog:
- Initial release of apple-viz skill.
- Generates Apple HIG-inspired bar, line, donut, progress, and stat card charts as PNG images from data.
- Supports light and dark mode, custom image size, and various chart types.
- Simple CLI interface with flexible data schemas.
- Uses Playwright (npx) or pyppeteer for high-fidelity screenshots.
